paths.title: Automation & Agents Academy
paths.tagline: Connect AI to your real tools and build automations you can actually trust
paths.description: A ladder from understanding what AI agents and automations really are through mapping a business process, connecting your first MCP connector, and building recurring AI-powered workflows with ChatGPT Tasks and scripted Claude Code automations, to designing safe, reviewed agent deployments — Claude Cowork delegations, Custom GPTs, and Claude Code hooks — with human checkpoints, error handling, and ongoing maintenance.
